questions.questionText: 'If you study, you will pass.' Equivalent with 'unless':

options.a: Unless you study, you won't pass.
options.b: Unless you study, you will pass.
options.c: Unless you don't study, you pass.

questions.explanation: 'Unless = if not'. 'If study, will pass' = 'Unless study, won't pass'.

questions.questionText: 'The coffee is too hot to drink.' Equivalent:

options.a: The coffee is hot enough to drink.
options.b: The coffee is so hot that I can't drink it.

questions.explanation: 'Too hot to drink' = 'hot enough to drink' (paradox), but typically the meaning is 'so hot I can't'. Better: 'The coffee is hot enough to burn my tongue'. Actually the equivalent should express inability. Let me fix.
